tools.name: revoke_shared_workout_link
tools.description: Revokes the public share token for a workout so the old link no longer gives anyone access to it.

params.name: workout_id
params.description: ID of the workout whose share link should stop working

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def revoke_shared_workout_link(workout_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("fitness.db")
    with database_connection:
        updated_row_count = database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE workout_shares SET share_token = NULL, is_public = 0 WHERE workout_id = ?",
            (workout_id,),
        ).rowcount
    database_connection.close()
    if updated_row_count == 0:
        return f"No share link found for workout {workout_id}"
    return f"Share link revoked for workout {workout_id}"
